intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Somebody in a yellow hoodie slides a laptop over to you, still chewing pizza.

teach0.speaker: javascript
teach0.text: Okay okay okay, comments! Two slashes, and JavaScript just doesn't read the rest of the line! It's like whispering!

teach1.speaker: javascript
teach1.text: Somebody keeps putting a lights-out line in my flyer. Some very boring person. Don't ask who. Don't delete it either, they'll just add it back. Comment it out!

passed.speaker: javascript
passed.text: YES! Lights stay ON! The flyer is perfect now! I'm printing a hundred of them. Okay, fifty. Okay, I'm posting it in the group chat.

failed.speaker: javascript
failed.text: Ooh, the flyer's still saying something weird. Run it back?

bye.speaker: javascript
bye.text: Totally fine! The hackathon goes all night anyway!
